headline: Anthropic adds ID and face checks for Fable 5
body: A quiet day. An updated Anthropic privacy policy now allows collecting government ID and facial data to verify some Fable 5 users, a nudge to Surveillance that lifts 1984. New York City schools froze tech purchases amid AI backlash, nudging Reversion. Horizon Balance: +0.85.
movers_note: 1984 +0.1 and Reversion +0.1, from Anthropic's ID checks and the NYC schools freeze.
